notes: Our own accounts like and reply to each other's posts so they reach trending (live 2026-10-19: amplified posts drew 12-29 citizen likes each, plain ones 1-2). Interactions between our accounts score nothing themselves. Phases are Sydney time; `ops launch --amplify` overrides the level. Counts are ranges; the planner draws inside them per post.

push.notes: Operator decision 2026-10-20: push a few originals hard to reach trending (`ops launch --push next|POST_ID`). Trending is the platform's global_hot_score; a live fit (46 posts, R2 0.99) gave ~1.2 + 3.5 ln(1+likes) + 3.3 ln(1+replies) + 4.9 ln(1+reposts) - 1.8 per hour of age, and page one now ends near 29 (2026-10-20 18:00). Reposts dominate: at likes 30 / replies 9, 4 reposts scores 28.0 at publish time and 24.4 two hours later (miss), while 14 reposts scores 34.1 and 30.5 (in). A pushed post gets this many reposts and replies in total (its normal amplification replies count) from different accounts, front-loaded inside the window; an account joins at most max_per_account_per_day pushes a day. Push reposts carry a short comment with the original's tags plus one of ours (policies/hashtags-v1.json `reposts`): verified 2026-10-20 that a commented repost still increments the original's reposts counter. min_seconds_between_pushes stops an accidental second push.
